summary: Gives additional guidance on deploying NAT64 and 464XLAT in IPv6 networks, including cellular, broadband, and enterprise. It covers optimizations and issues for IPv6-only connectivity, such as DNS64, applications using literal IPv4 addresses, and IPv4-only hosts or applications.

eli5.summary: Some websites still speak only the old internet language. This is advice for networks that must translate for them so everyone can still talk.
